Steph / Laura / Asha — I ran the proration math with the details provided (effective 2026-08-10 inclusive) and attached a calc workbook for transparency (proration_calc.xlsx). Summary / recommendation below:

Summary (120 -> 108 on 2026-08-10; monthly seat price $450 per seat):
- Full-month seats (1–9 Aug): 120 seats for 9 days = 120 * $450 * (9/31) = $15,548.39
- Partial-month seats (10–31 Aug): 108 seats for 22 days = 108 * $450 * (22/31) = $34,838.71
- Gross charge for August = $50,387.10
- Credit for seats removed mid-cycle (difference vs. billed full-month baseline) = $6,583.87 (applied as invoice adjustment)

Entity / VAT handling options:
1) Two invoices (recommended for accounting separation):
   - PulseHealth US: Invoice for US-legal-seat portion (we will allocate revenues based on your legal entity split — please confirm percentages). No VAT applied for US entity.
   - PulseHealth EMEA: Separate invoice with reverse-charge note and VAT zeroed where applicable; we will include the EU VAT registration number on the invoice and add the reverse-charge legal note.

2) Single invoice with line-level allocation (acceptable if your accounting wants one doc):
   - We can issue a single invoice that contains two blocks titled with each legal entity and an internal memo for revenue recognition. This is less clean for entity-level revenue recognition and may complicate inter-company accounting on your side.

Recommendation: Issue two invoices to match legal entities. We'll apply the $6,583.87 as an invoice-level credit on the August invoice(s) (not as an account credit), as requested. Laura — please prepare two proforma invoices: one for PulseHealth US and one for PulseHealth EMEA, with the credit applied pro-rata to each based on the legal-entity allocation Asha confirms.

Asha — attaching proration_calc.xlsx for your review. If you confirm entity split (example: 70% US / 30% EMEA), Laura and I will produce signed proformas and the DocuSign amendment link to finalize the seat deactivation.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
Attachments: proration_calc.xlsx

1) Can Redwood apply the $6,583.87 as an invoice adjustment on the EMEA invoice (we prefer the adjustment to appear on the EMEA invoice so that our EU GL closes cleanly)? If you must split the credit, please allocate it 65/35 consistent with the revenue split.
2) Please confirm that reverse-charge wording and our VAT ID (EU-VAT-882117) will be present on the EMEA invoice.

If you prepare the proformas today we can sign the amendment by tomorrow and get this into our August month close.

—Asha
